title: College, Career, and Military Readiness: Materials and Services

onscreen_lines.desc: Market Baskets 1 -College & Career Readiness Assessments, Licenses & Certificationswhich include materials with the primary purpose of assessing student growth and mastery of concepts and skills, and college & career readiness, such as: Advancement Placement (AP) International Baccalaureate (IB) Preliminary Scholastic Aptitude Test (PSAT) American College Test (ACT) Scholastic Aptitude Test (SAT) Texas Success Initiative (TSI) Industry certifications for vocational programs State licensing for vocational programs TEA approved certification and licenses
onscreen_lines.note: Please include the general discount off for all catalog items in this market basket, if applicable. A response of "0" is acceptable if vendor's published catalog is already reflective of all discounts. If vendor does not offer a general discount for catalog items, please select the "NO BID" option. Note: Failure to respond to at least one of the proposed discount/price structures under the "Line Items" tab shall constitute a non-responsive bid. Alternatively, vendor may attach a price list in the "Response Attachments" tab, if needed. Supplemental catalogs and/or price structure documentation should be scanned and uploaded to the “Response Attachments” tab. A published link to catalogs and/or pricing and detailing goods and/or services may be provided, if applicable. Links to catalog pricing must be kept current during the term of the awarded agreement. It is the intent of HISD to award a manufacturer’s complete line of products, and services when possible.

onscreen_lines.desc: Market Basket 2 - College & Career Readiness Instructional & Preparation Materials, Supplies & Equipment which include: Materials, supplies, rentals, equipment and services that support vocational/career program areas including but not limited to including: agriculture, architecture, construction, arts, a/v production, business, marketing, health occupations, STEM, instructional technology, culinary arts, cosmetology, education, finance, government and public administration, hospitality services, manufacturing, welding, firefighter and emergency services, law and justice, flight instruction and transportation fields. College and career exploration materials. Test preparation materials for college and career readiness assessments. New & Used Textbooks for college level courses (AP, IB, Dual Credit). Specialized equipment and supplies related to vocational/career program areas. Equipment for the related to vocational/career program areas, which include but are not limited to tools kits, generators, and machines. Supplies and materials which support the vocational/career program areas, which include but are not limited to uniforms, safety equipment, tools. Rental and services which support the support the vocational/career program areas. Technology equipment, such as but not limited to simulators, 3-D printers, and robotics. Materials and equipment, which support STEM education such as but not limited to models, mannequins. Testing techniques, item banks and practice materials. Specialized programming materials and equipment that align to elementary age exploratory learning.

onscreen_lines.desc: Market Basket 5 - College & Career Readiness Software which includes but is not limited to: A. Online platforms and software for students to: Explore college/career options Prepare for college and career readiness examinations Engage in CTE/vocational subject areas and activities Research and apply for scholarships and college B. Online platforms and software for staff to: Track and monitor student progress on college applications Track and monitor financial aid and scholarship data (i.e. TASFA/FAFSA) Communicate with students around the college and career processes Monitor student progress with regard to personal graduation plans and endorsements C. Software D. National college enrollment and persistence data
